home.title: Find a hostel or mess you can trust: real seats, real menus, real prices.
home.subtitle: Every place here is run by its owner. Seats come from the owner's own room register, so “free” means free.
home.why1: Counted from the owner's room register, with the time it was last checked.
home.why2: The mess owner updates the weekly menu. You see today's plate before you join.
home.why3: Rent, deposit and food charges are shown up front. No hidden extras.
home.why4: You talk to the owner directly. Nobody takes a cut.
home.how1: Filter by area, budget, food and facilities.
home.how2: Send a request with your move-in date. Your number is verified once.
home.how3: The owner approves, gives you a room and your digital ID card.
home.ownerStrip: Run a hostel or mess? Free tools for seats, menus, fees, expenses and salaries.
home.a1: Yes. Searching, comparing and sending requests is free.
home.q2: How do I know a place is real?
home.a2: Every listing is reviewed before it appears. A Verified tick means someone checked the place in person.
home.q3: Why do girls' hostels hide the exact address?
home.a3: For safety. The full address and phone are shared once the owner accepts your request.
home.q4: Do I pay through the app?
home.a4: No. You pay the owner directly by UPI or cash, then tap “I paid”. The owner confirms.
